title: Photograph Standards and Review Periods across the Keyturn Vehicle Listing Classes
content:
Photographs are the evidence a Keyturn Vehicle Listing carries before it goes live, and each class sets its own count, its own angles and its own resolution floor. The review period and the activation fee belong to the same schedule, because both attach to the listing at the point it is put up for review.

| Class | Photographs a listing must carry | Distinct exterior angles | Interior photographs | Shortest edge of a photograph (pixels) | Review period (business days) | Activation fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 8 | 4 | 3 | 1024 | 3 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 10 | 6 | 4 | 1280 | 3 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 14 | 8 | 6 | 1600 | 2 | 49.00 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 18 | 10 | 8 | 2048 | 2 | 99.00 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 24 | 12 | 10 | 2560 | 5 | 250.00 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 12 | 6 | 6 | 1280 | 4 | 75.00 |

### Points of judgement

*How the counts sit together.* The photograph count is the total the listing must carry; the exterior angle count and the interior count are each drawn from that total. A Keyturn Premium Class Listing carrying 14 photographs in all, of which 8 are distinct exterior angles and 6 are interior views, meets its row exactly.

*Where the resolution floor bites.* The pixel figure is the shortest edge, so a photograph of 1600 pixels by 2400 pixels meets the Keyturn Premium Class Listing floor of 1600 pixels, and one of 1500 pixels by 3000 pixels does not.

*What the fee figure of 0.00 USD means.* The Keyturn Economy Class Listing and the Keyturn Standard Class Listing charge no activation fee at all; the remaining classes charge the figure their row carries.
